title: Statement compilation
statement: Given a code layout with $F$ local variables per frame, a list of procedure entry positions, and a dispatcher position, the compiler maps a statement and a starting code position to a list of Word RAM instructions. It emits no instructions for skip; evaluates and stores expressions for assignments and stores; concatenates compiled code for sequences, placing the second statement after the first according to their sizes; and emits condition checks, branch code, and jumps for conditionals and loops. For a call, it evaluates the arguments, creates and initializes a new frame, jumps to the selected procedure entry (or position $0$ if the procedure index is out of range), then stores the returned value in the designated variable.
